name: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd
title: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd - 532313 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Resi pre-sales FY26 ₹3,405 cr with FY27 guidance ₹4,500–5,000 cr held; PAT ₹298 cr vs ₹61 cr on IC leasing and OCs, but management cited war-driven footfall slowdown and affordable drag.

triggers.label: IC lease revenue ₹360 cr in Q4
triggers.quote: we received, as you can see, 360 crores worth of new lease revenue that came in

triggers.label: Footfall slowdown from war
triggers.quote: we have seen some slowdown in terms of footfalls in our sales gallery

triggers.label: Mitsui Fudosan multi-project JV
triggers.quote: Mitsui is already committed for another deal, and they are looking for additional deals beyond that

triggers.label: Ultra-high-end slowdown only
triggers.quote: I think we are seeing an impact at a real high end, which is a luxury segment, but we don't operate in the luxury segment

guidance.quote: we have given guidance of 4,500 to 5,000 crores for our pre-sales for FY27
I would say we will be north of 10,000 crores
we have 8 OCs planned for this year. 2 of them have already happened
we have always guided that this business will give us 400 to 500 crores every year

prior_guidance_check.quote: We had planned almost eight launches, five launches happened
We received eight OCs last year

red_flags.label: Launches slipped; 5 of 8 done
red_flags.quote: We had planned almost eight launches, five launches happened

red_flags.label: Sales footfall slowdown attributed to war
red_flags.quote: we have seen some slowdown in terms of footfalls in our sales gallery

red_flags.label: Affordable projects near-zero or negative margins
red_flags.quote: they are close to single digits, in some cases even negative

evasions.quote: Now, external factors as well as our ability to execute will demonstrate how far we are or how much we can overdeliver on that.
I think we are still hoping to go deep in the existing 3 markets before go back to Gurgaon
